title: Inventory
catalogOnly: Your business does not track inventory: this is the product catalog. Selling without deducting stock is perfectly fine.

sourceHint.drawer: Paid from the drawer: subtracted from the cash expected at closing.
sourceHint.other: Not paid from the drawer: recorded but does not change the cash closing.

problems.amount: Enter a valid amount (two decimals at most).
problems.quantity: Enter a valid quantity (three decimals at most).
problems.name: Enter the name.
problems.lines: Add at least one product to the purchase.
problems.line: Check the highlighted lines: the product or name, quantity or cost is missing.
problems.paid: The amount paid cannot be more than the total.
problems.barcode: The barcode allows up to 64 characters.
problems.shortCode: The short code allows up to 16 characters.

errors.BARCODE_IN_USE: Another product already uses that barcode.
errors.SHORT_CODE_IN_USE: Another product already uses that short code.
errors.STOCK_NOT_TRACKED: This product does not track stock.
errors.INVALID_PHONE: The phone number does not look valid.
errors.INVALID_PAID: The paid amount must be between zero and the total.
errors.INVALID_NAME: The name is missing or too long.
errors.INVALID_LINES: A purchase needs between 1 and 200 lines.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only an admin or the owner can deactivate products.
errors.PRODUCT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: A product sold by weight or with an open price cannot be in a promotion.
errors.INVALID_DATES: The end date is before the start date.

form.name: Name
form.costHint: Leave it empty if you do not know it; used to work out profit.
form.quick: Show in the register's quick products
form.trackHint: deducts every sale and warns when it runs low
form.initialStockHint: Optional: saved as the initial count.
form.barcodeHint: Scan it or type it; up to 64 characters.
form.priceSuggestedHint: Offered at sale time; it can be changed on every sale.
form.noCategoriesHint: There are no categories yet; create them from the register or Settings.

pricingHelp.FIXED: Always charged at the same price.
pricingHelp.BY_WEIGHT: The price is per weight unit and is multiplied by the weight.
pricingHelp.OPEN: No fixed price: the price is asked on every sale.

stock.title: Tracked products
stock.idleHint: They have stock but did not sell in the last month: idle money.
stock.negativeHint: More was sold than counted. Count again to fix it.

actionHint.count: Enter what you counted; the system works out the difference and keeps it in the history.
actionHint.damage: Damaged, expired or own-use quantity. It subtracts from stock.
actionHint.return: Quantity a customer returned. It adds to stock.

import.title: Import products and stock
import.intro: Upload a CSV file (Excel: Save as CSV). You will see a preview before anything is saved; what already exists is updated, not duplicated. Up to {{max}} rows.
import.mapHint: {{rows}} data rows, separated by {{delimiter}}. Check which field each column belongs to.
import.needName: Pick which column is the product name.
import.tooMany: The file has {{rows}} rows and the maximum is {{max}}. Split it into several.
import.noPrice: There is no price column: new products cannot be created (existing ones are still updated).
import.previewNote: Nothing has been saved yet. Review the result and, if it looks right, apply the import.
import.confirmBody_one: {{count}} row will be saved. Rows with errors are skipped.
import.confirmBody_other: {{count}} rows will be saved. Rows with errors are skipped.

code.INVALID_UNIT: Invalid unit (UNIT, LB, KG, L, M)
code.BARCODE_IN_USE: Barcode already used by another product
code.SHORT_CODE_IN_USE: Short code already used by another product
code.STOCK_NOT_TRACKED: The product does not track stock

purchases.payTooMuch: That is more than owed; it is recorded anyway.
purchases.voidHint: The stock it added is undone and the money of its payments goes back into the calculation. A purchase is not edited: void it and record it again.
purchases.voidPaymentHint: The money goes back into the closing calculation and the purchase is owed again.
purchases.supplierNameHint: The name is enough, you do not need to register the supplier.

suppliers.optional: Suppliers are optional: a purchase can carry just a name.

history.title: History
history.empty: This product has no recorded changes yet.

promotions.intro: “3 for C$ 100” on one or more products: the register applies it automatically (offline too). Pausing or changing one reaches the phones when they sync.
promotions.deleteConfirm: Yes, delete it (sales do not change)
promotions.notEligible: {{name}} is sold by weight or with an open price: not included
promotions.unknownCode: Code {{code}} is not in the catalog
promotions.noBenefit: With these prices there is no discount.

form.name: Name
form.activeHint: a paused one is not applied at the register
form.productsHint: Units of these products add up (2 Toña and 1 Victoria count as 3). Products sold by weight or with an open price are not included.
form.codeHint: Scan with the reader or type the code and press Enter: it is added to the list.

problems.name: Type a name (up to 80 characters).
problems.dates: The end date is before the start date.
